description: This file appears to be documentation content for the Azure Video Generation API integration within the LiteLLM framework. It includes code snippets for generating videos, checking status, downloading content, and configuration instructions, but it is not executable source code itself.

methods.name: video_generation
methods.description: Generates a video based on a prompt with specified parameters.

methods.name: video_status
methods.description: Checks the current status of a video generation request.

methods.name: video_content
methods.description: Retrieves the content bytes of a completed video.

methods.name: video_remix
methods.description: Creates a remix/edit of an existing video with a new prompt and optional reference image.
